items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I made the recordings with Dave. ... We made those with him. ... I worked there with him and somebody else I worked with Dave. Oh, at the downtown, I worked at the downtown with Dave. And quite a few jobs, other outside jobs with Dave.

ctx.x: No, yeah, banjo before violin. That's right. I took up banjo in 1925. About a year and a half later, I went to work with Paul Moody. You might have heard of Paul Moody. I worked with his band for quite a while. Then I decided I wanted to take up sax. I took lessons from Professor David Jones on the Pelican. He used to be an old Pelican Rampart and Grabby. Then I began to play a little bit. Then I went to work playing sax. The Paul Moody band. Then from there, I went to the quarters. I stayed in the quarters for…
